So I finally tried that new gym downtown, and wow, what an experience! First of all, the place is massive. Like, ridiculously huge. I couldn't even find the locker room for the first ten minutes. Had to ask someone, and they looked at me like I'd just landed from another planet. But once I figured out where everything was, it was actually pretty great. They've got these fancy machines I've never seen before. One of them looked like it was designed by NASA or something. I just stood there staring at it for a while, pretending to stretch. You know what I mean? When you don't want to look clueless so you just act like you're warming up? Anyway, I stuck to the treadmill because, well, even I can't mess that up. The music was way too loud though. Who picks these playlists? It's like someone just hit shuffle on every genre ever invented. But hey, I'll probably go back. The smoothie bar alone is worth it!
